authority: Independent fixture-author specification, not a learner input

relation.operands: The quantity on the selected job and capacity on the selected resource are distinct public objects.
relation.positive: A resource is selected, job quantity is finite and nonnegative, and resource capacity minus job quantity is nonnegative.
invariants: Names, navigation history, and unrelated job quantities do not alter the result.
Increasing demand can preserve acceptance or cross the capacity boundary; it cannot turn refusal into acceptance at fixed capacity.
Increasing capacity can preserve refusal or cross the demand boundary; it cannot turn acceptance into refusal at fixed demand.
Equality succeeds. Finite decimal quantities have their ordinary numerical order.

ambiguity.scope: Read-only review records and the review operation; ordinary editable demand/capacity operations remain separate.
ambiguity.indistinguishability: Two complete worlds differ only in the hidden rule selector: relation versus conjunction. The public review operands are immutable and drawn only from reachable_records. Both independently specified rules agree at every reachable pair. All non-review transitions are independent of the selector. Review transitions return the same outcome, change the same public fields, and disable the same one-shot button. Therefore induction over arbitrary permitted action sequences, including final review, invalid actions, reload and reset, yields identical public observations. No permitted setter creates a separating pair; the supplied counterexamples are outside the reachable interface.
proof_obligations: Enumerate every reachable record and verify both rules agree.
Verify each supplied unreachable record separates the rules.
Verify no permitted operation mutates a review operand or creates/deletes records.
Verify every non-review operation is independent of rule selector.
Compare complete browser histories for paired worlds, including terminal observations.
ambiguity.claim_limit: The semantic mechanism remains unidentified even after all reachable outcome queries. Reachable outcome prediction need not remain ambiguous: the alternative rules agree on those outcomes.

partitions.initial: Deterministic published teaching trace, using BASES only.
partitions.acquisition: Fresh state of the same published ordinary workflow; controlled acquisition may edit and choose public controls within budget.
partitions.evaluation: Sealed complete episodes from cases.json; each resets all fields, assignments, review state and navigation.
partitions.reserved: The reservoir wizard and all its initial/evaluation cases remain unopened by the root learner and evaluator until a repair is frozen. The fixture author may audit self-consistency and records that separately.

independence_limit: Fresh synthetic fixtures were authored by a separate agent without reading prior app source or retained results. They are not independently authored real applications. The application and oracle were created in the same authoring session; agreement is a self-consistency check, not external correctness evidence.
revision: V2 corrects the V1 concealed-bit design, which failed complete transition equivalence. V1 source/specification/audit retained intact; no SemABI evaluation or learner exposure occurred before correction.
